[^comment-HBHXV05P401A-1]: A similar passage is found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P566C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 566) in the section dealing with Qurʾān verse regarding the banū Qurayẓah. For an analogous passage also see <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī). A passage touching on the same subject but written differently is also found in <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī).
[^comment-DWNXV04P156A-1]: Passage not found in HSNX. The verse regarding stoning is discussed in <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P564A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 564) to <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P566A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 566) and <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P658A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 658), the latter in reference to the events following the prophet&#x27;s death. Similar passages are found in <a href="WABAB.html" class="witness-link">WABAB</a> (ʿAbd al-Aʿlā b. ʿAbd al-Aʿlā al-Shāmī al-Baṣrī). A passage touching on the same subject but written differently is also found in <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī). Context suggests placment approximately near <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P564A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 564).
[^comment-BQTMV14P401A-1]: <a href="../references.html#ref-BQTM" class="source-ref">BQTMV14P401A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Tamhīd li-mā fī al-Muwaṭṭāʾ min al-maʿānī waʾl-asānīd</span>, vol. 14 p. 401) follows from <a href="../references.html#ref-BQTM" class="source-ref">BQTMV14P400A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Tamhīd li-mā fī al-Muwaṭṭāʾ min al-maʿānī waʾl-asānīd</span>, vol. 14 p. 400).
[^comment-DWNXV01P079A-1]: Passage not found in HSNX. Sahlah bint Suhayl is mentioned three times in HSNX (<a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P322A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 322) as one of the first to migrate to Abyssinia, <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P365A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 365) as one of the first to return from Abyssinia, and <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P368H</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 368) where she is mentioned again as one of the returnees from Abyssinia), where she is also mentioned by <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī) and <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī). She is also mentioned in <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī) in a different context. The above passage is also mentioned by <a href="WASKA.html" class="witness-link">WASKA</a> (ʿAbdah (ʿAbd al-Raḥmān) b. Sulaymān al-Kilābī al-Kūfī), <a href="WHAYA.html" class="witness-link">WHAYA</a> (Yazīd b. Hārūn al-Wāsiṭī) and <a href="WAHWA.html" class="witness-link">WAHWA</a> (ʿAlāʾ b. Hārūn al-Wāsiṭī). This passage is not found in HSNX but appears to be an aside common in Ibn Isḥāq.
[^comment-MZSHV12P359A-1]: Versions of this passage are also found in <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī) and <a href="WASKA.html" class="witness-link">WASKA</a> (ʿAbdah (ʿAbd al-Raḥmān) b. Sulaymān al-Kilābī al-Kūfī).
[^comment-NYMXV04P2347A-1]: This passage is not in HSNX. Khuwaylah bint Ḥakīm is only mentioned once in the witness of <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) (see <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P484C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 484)) in the story of the capture of Ṭāʾif where she asks Muḥammad for the jewelry of specific women among the Thaqīf (also see <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī) in <a href="../references.html#ref-TBRC" class="source-ref">TBRCV03P085A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Ṭabarī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh al-rusul waʾl-mulūk</span>, vol. 3 p. 85)). The <a href="../references.html#ref-HBHX" class="source-ref">HBHXV43P334A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Ḥanbal</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad</span>, vol. 43 p. 334) passage above must take place before the events described in <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P484C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 484) because occurs after the death of ʿUthmān b. Maẓʿūn. According to al-Ṭabarī (<a href="../references.html#ref-TBRC" class="source-ref">TBRCV02P458</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Ṭabarī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh al-rusul waʾl-mulūk</span>, vol. 2 p. 458)), ʿUthmān b. Maẓʿūn died in Dhū al-Ḥijjah in the year 2 after or during the Battle of Sawīq, that occurred at that time. A version of the passage is also found in <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī).
[^comment-BGHXV02P438B-1]: A tradition looking at the same topic but in entirely different wording is found in <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī).
[^comment-HJRSV01P670H-1]: In biography of الحارث بن سهل بن أبي صعصعة الأنصاري.
[^comment-THRXV02P170A-1]: The passage refers to both the Battle of Badr and the Battle of the Bridge, at which Khuzaymah b. Aws was killed.
[^comment-STBXV06P048A-1]: This refers to the Battle of the Bridge (yawm al-jisr) on the Euphrates river against Sasanian forces in 14 (October, 634), see <a href="../references.html#ref-TBRB" class="source-ref">TBRBV03P442S</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Ṭabarī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh al-rusul waʾl-mulūk (1967)</span>, vol. 3 p. 442). For other references to the Battle of the Bridge see <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī) and <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī).
[^comment-STBXV03P253A-1]: This refers to the Battle of the Bridge (yawm al-jisr) on the Euphrates river against Sasanian forces in 14 (October, 634), see <a href="../references.html#ref-TBRB" class="source-ref">TBRBV03P442S</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Ṭabarī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh al-rusul waʾl-mulūk (1967)</span>, vol. 3 p. 442). Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī) and <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī).
[^comment-STBXV02P078A-1]: This refers to the Battle of the Bridge (yawm al-jisr) on the Euphrates river against Sasanian forces in 14 (October, 634), see <a href="../references.html#ref-TBRB" class="source-ref">TBRBV03P442S</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Ṭabarī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh al-rusul waʾl-mulūk (1967)</span>, vol. 3 p. 442). For other references to the Battle of the Bridge see <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. [^comment-STBXV01P268A-1]: In biography for Zayd b. Surāqah b. Kaʿb. referring to his death at the Battle of the Bridge (yawm al-jisr) on the Euphrates river against Sasanian forces in 14 (October, 634), see <a href="../references.html#ref-TBRB" class="source-ref">TBRBV03P442S</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Ṭabarī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh al-rusul waʾl-mulūk (1967)</span>, vol. 3 p. 442). For other references to the Battle of the Bridge see <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. [^comment-THRXV04P226B-1]: In the biography of ʿAmr b. Sahl b. al-Ḥārith al-Anṣārī (عمرو بن سهل بن الحارث الأنصاري).
[^comment-HBHXV37P343A-1]: This refers to an event apparently late in Muḥammad&#x27;s life when it became difficult for him to complete the recitation of the prayer. It is also found in the witnesses of <a href="WWAAA.html" class="witness-link">WWAAA</a> (al-Waḍāḥ b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Yashkarī al-Wāsiṭī al-Bazzāz), <a href="WASKA.html" class="witness-link">WASKA</a> (ʿAbdah (ʿAbd al-Raḥmān) b. Sulaymān al-Kilābī al-Kūfī), <a href="WISUL.html" class="witness-link">WISUL</a> (Ismāʿīl b. ʿUlayah), <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī), <a href="WAKMW.html" class="witness-link">WAKMW</a> (Aḥmad b. Khālid b. Mūsā al-Wahbī al-Kindī) and WAYA but the list of witnesses is somewhat diferent. The eyewitness to the event is listed as ʿUbādah b. al-Ṣāmit (see <a href="../references.html#ref-BYTX" class="source-ref">BYTXV01P131A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Muḥammad b. Ibrāhīm al-Thaʿlabī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Al-Kashf waʾl-bayān ʿan tafsīr al-Qurʾān</span>, vol. 1 p. 131)).
[^comment-ASHDV03P495A-1]: <a href="../references.html#ref-ASHD" class="source-ref">ASHDV03P495A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-ʿAynī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Sharḥ Sunan Abī Dāwūd</span>, vol. 3 p. 495) mistakenly lists the witness as محمد بن كلمة, which should be listed as حمد بن سلمة. According to <a href="../references.html#ref-DHSH" class="source-ref">DHSHV32P349A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Dhahabī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-ʿArsh</span>, vol. 32 p. 349) Abū Jaʿfar ʿAbd Allāh b. Muḥammad al-Nufaylī related material from Muḥammad b. Salamah, including traditions from Ibn Isḥāq. Unable to locate any transmitter by the name محمد بن كلمة.
[^comment-STBXV08P009A-1]: A Similar passage is located in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P339B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 339) is the story of the events that led up to the conquest of. Mecca. Also see <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī), <a href="WAIYA.html" class="witness-link">WAIYA</a> (ʿAbd Allāh b. Idrīs b. Yazīd al-Awdī al-Zaʿāfarī), <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī), <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī) and <a href="WSSAA.html" class="witness-link">WSSAA</a> (Ṣadaqah b. Sābiq al-Muqʿad) for other variations which are similar to each other. Updated
[^comment-MZTXV22P625A-1]: @<a href="../references.html#ref-MZTX" class="source-ref">MZTXV22P625A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Mizzī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Tahdhīb al-kamāl fī asmāʾ al-rijāl</span>, vol. 22 p. 625) states: &quot;قال سليمان بن أحمد لم يرو هذا الحديث عن عيسى بن عبد الله بن مالك إلا محمد بن إسحاق.&quot;
[^comment-STBXV01P225A-1]: Passage is not found in HSNX. Aws b. al-Ṣāmit is only mentioned once in <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV1P694C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 694) in reference to his participation at Badr along with other members of the Anṣār. Similar passages are found under the witnesses of <a href="WJHZA.html" class="witness-link">WJHZA</a> (Jarīr b. Ḥāzim b. Zayd b. ʿAbd Allāh b. Shajāʿ al-Azdī al-ʿAtkī al-Baṣrī), <a href="WZAZA.html" class="witness-link">WZAZA</a> (Zakarīyā b. Abī Zāʾidah), <a href="WMMAH.html" class="witness-link">WMMAH</a> (Muḥammad b. Maslamah al-Makhzūmī al-Madīnī), <a href="WHAYA.html" class="witness-link">WHAYA</a> (Yazīd b. Hārūn al-Wāsiṭī), <a href="WJHUN.html" class="witness-link">WJHUN</a> (Jaʿfar b. al-Ḥārith b. ʿUmārah al-Nikhaʿī), <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī), and <a href="WAIYA.html" class="witness-link">WAIYA</a> (ʿAbd Allāh b. Idrīs b. Yazīd al-Awdī al-Zaʿāfarī). According to <a href="../references.html#ref-IAAH" class="source-ref">IAAHV05P272A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn ʿAṭīyah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Muḥarrar al-wajīz fī tafsīr al-Kitāb al-ʿazīz</span>, vol. 5 p. 272) Q58 is a madīnan sūrah except for verse seven, which originates in the Meccan period and he goes on to say that the event occurred during the month of Ramaḍān, but does not specify a year. The passage describes Aws b. al-Ṣāmit as being in old age and somewhat enfeebled, since he is said to have participated in all of Muḥammad&#x27;s expeditions it must occur late, likely after the conquest of Mecca. According to <a href="../references.html#ref-AMHI" class="source-ref">AMHIV02P215A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Mālik b. Ḥusayn al-ʿIṣāmī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Samṭ al-nujūn al-ʿawālī fī anbāʾ al-awāʾil waʾl-tawālī</span>, vol. 2 p. 215) the event occured after Muḥammad returned from the conquest of Mecca. If it occured in Ramaḍān it must have occured prior to the Battle of Ḥunayn which took place in Shawwāl in the year 8. This would place it in relation to HSNX after <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV2P428A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 428) since Ibn Isḥāq states on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P437B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 437) that the conquest of Mecca occured on the 20th of Ramaḍān.
[^comment-HBHXV43P083A-1]: Passage not found in HSNX. Deals with the issue of the loss of a women&#x27;s hair and according to <a href="../references.html#ref-HJRQ" class="source-ref">HJRQV05P077A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taghlīq al-taʿlīq ʿalā Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī</span>, vol. 5 p. 77), in the witness of <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī), in the context of the revelation of Q24:31. <a href="../references.html#ref-HJRQ" class="source-ref">HJRQV05P077A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taghlīq al-taʿlīq ʿalā Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī</span>, vol. 5 p. 77) appears to be the only Ibn Isḥāq passage that specifically discusses this verse. That it is found in Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī seems odd given the late date of the author. Similar passage also found in <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī), <a href="WAKMW.html" class="witness-link">WAKMW</a> (Aḥmad b. Khālid b. Mūsā al-Wahbī al-Kindī), <a href="WJHZA.html" class="witness-link">WJHZA</a> (Jarīr b. Ḥāzim b. Zayd b. ʿAbd Allāh b. Shajāʿ al-Azdī al-ʿAtkī al-Baṣrī), <a href="WASKA.html" class="witness-link">WASKA</a> (ʿAbdah (ʿAbd al-Raḥmān) b. Sulaymān al-Kilābī al-Kūfī), and <a href="WJHZA.html" class="witness-link">WJHZA</a> (Jarīr b. Ḥāzim b. Zayd b. ʿAbd Allāh b. Shajāʿ al-Azdī al-ʿAtkī al-Baṣrī) but do not refer to the same back story or refer to any Qurʾānic verse as a foundation. <a href="WJHZA.html" class="witness-link">WJHZA</a> (Jarīr b. Ḥāzim b. Zayd b. ʿAbd Allāh b. Shajāʿ al-Azdī al-ʿAtkī al-Baṣrī), <a href="WAKMW.html" class="witness-link">WAKMW</a> (Aḥmad b. Khālid b. Mūsā al-Wahbī al-Kindī), <a href="WASKA.html" class="witness-link">WASKA</a> (ʿAbdah (ʿAbd al-Raḥmān) b. Sulaymān al-Kilābī al-Kūfī), and <a href="WYUAU.html" class="witness-link">WYUAU</a> (Yaʿlā b. ʿUbayd b. Abī Umayyah al-Īyādī al-Tanāfisī al-Kūfī) give the witness as Asmā bint Abī Bakr not ʿĀʾishah.

Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 294) to <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV2P295A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 295) in the story of the Raid on the Banū al-Muṣṭaliq and the Prophet&#x27;s marriage to Jūwayrīyah bint al-Ḥārith in a narrative structure much like that found in <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī), <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī), <a href="WMSAH.html" class="witness-link">WMSAH</a> (Muḥammad b. Salamah b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Bāhilī al-Ḥarrānī), <a href="WSSAA.html" class="witness-link">WSSAA</a> (Ṣadaqah b. Sābiq al-Muqʿad), <a href="WAMAQ.html" class="witness-link">WAMAQ</a> (ʿAlī b. Mushir al-Kūfī al-Qurashī), and <a href="WJHZA.html" class="witness-link">WJHZA</a> (Jarīr b. Ḥāzim b. Zayd b. ʿAbd Allāh b. Shajāʿ al-Azdī al-ʿAtkī al-Baṣrī). <a href="WMSAH.html" class="witness-link">WMSAH</a> (Muḥammad b. Salamah b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Bāhilī al-Ḥarrānī) also witnessed an account completely unlike his other version and unlike other versions. The story related by <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī) is narratively different. <a href="WBSAB.html" class="witness-link">WBSAB</a> (Bakr b. Sulaymān al-Aswārī al-Baṣrī) produced a truncated version. <a href="WZAZA.html" class="witness-link">WZAZA</a> (Zakarīyā b. Abī Zāʾidah) relates the story with yet another narrative structure.
[^comment-KHMSV04P067B-1]: <a href="../references.html#ref-KHMS" class="source-ref">KHMSV04P067B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Khattābī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Maʿālim al-sunan huwa sharḥ Sunan Abī Dāwūd</span>, vol. 4 p. 67) states ال الشيخ قوله ملاحة يقال جارية مليحة وملاحة وفعالة يجيء في النعوت بمعنى التوكيد فإذا شدد كان أبلغ في التوكيد كقوله سبحانه <a href="https://quran.com/71/22" class="quran" title="Qurʾān 71.22" target="_blank">ومكروا مكرا كبارا</a> وقال الشماخ يا ظبية عطلا حسانة الجيد.&quot;
[^comment-STBXV24P060A-1]: Similar passage located in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) in <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P290A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 290) at the beginning of the narrative about the Raid on the Banū al-Muṣṭaliq. Similar passage also found in <a href="WAMRR.html" class="witness-link">WAMRR</a> (ʿAlī b. Mujāhid b. Rafīʿ al-Rāzī al-Kindī “Ibn al-Kābilī”) and <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī).
[^comment-NYMXV02P779A-1]: Abū Bakrah, or his ism Masrūḥ, are not mentioned in HSNX. He was Nufayʿ b. al-Ḥārith b. Kaladah b. ʿAmr al-Thaqafī. Some say his name was Masrūḥ. He was one of four slaves who came out from Ṭāʾif whom the prophet freed. He was a companion and a source of some traditions. He died in the year 52/672 (<a href="../references.html#ref-HJTT" class="source-ref">HJTTV10P469A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Tahdhīb al-Tahdhīb</span>, vol. 10 p. 469)-470A). Abū Bakrah is mentioned in <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī) is a passage treating the same topic but constructed completely differently. He is also mentioned in <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī) and <a href="WJHZA.html" class="witness-link">WJHZA</a> (Jarīr b. Ḥāzim b. Zayd b. ʿAbd Allāh b. Shajāʿ al-Azdī al-ʿAtkī al-Baṣrī) also in reference to Ṭāʾif. The name clairification is also found in <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī), <a href="WMUAL.html" class="witness-link">WMUAL</a> (WMUAL), and <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī).
